title: Founder, moval.living
bio:
John Menke is the founder of Moval.Living, a local business directory built to help residents discover and support Moreno Valley businesses. He's been a real estate broker and mortgage loan originator in the Inland Empire since 2014, currently operating Menke Real Estate and Rate Trac Mortgage.

An Army veteran and recipient of the Army Commendation Medal, John holds a Master's degree in Negotiation, Conflict Resolution and Peacebuilding — a background he puts to work daily, both at the negotiating table and in the community. He's deeply invested in Moreno Valley's civic life, currently serving his second term as Chairman of the Board for the Moreno Valley Chamber of Commerce, and volunteering with organizations including American Legion Post 574 and US VETS. He's a co-organizer of Cars, Guitars & Handlebars, a free annual community Veterans Day event at the March ARB Commissary benefitting US VETS.

When he's not closing deals or writing about the community he calls home, John builds technology — from AI-powered tools for real estate and small business, to Moval.Living itself — with the same goal driving all of his work: helping Moreno Valley thrive.

John is a proud member of Toastmasters. If you'd like John to speak at your event, reach out.
